title: 60-hour climate relay action originating in November continued into December
status: The organizer follow-up published 1 December says the relay action that began 30 November was underway that day. The planned 60-hour end near 2 December is not verified; actual closure and simultaneous attendance remain unknown. This is a cross-month continuation, not a new December event.
notes: Reused source card BEL202011_S005 after actual open and target-specific assessment in November; no new request was made. The 60 people were described as relays, not a concurrent crowd. Keep ownership with November onset and do not infer a 50-person single gathering.
